daily.today_energy: The universe is giving you that quiet confidence energy today, Libra. You're naturally magnetic right now—people are drawn to your authenticity. Trust the vibe shift happening around you.

daily.career: Your ideas are hitting different today. That project or proposal you've been sitting on? The energy supports you speaking up. Your perspective matters more than you realize.
daily.health: Your body's asking for balance—maybe some gentle movement or time outside. Listen to what feels nourishing rather than punishing. Rest is productive when you need it.

weekly.overview: Your scales are finding balance this week, Libra. There's a gentle cosmic energy pushing you toward authenticity—stop people-pleasing for five seconds and ask yourself what YOU actually want. The universe is listening.
weekly.love: Whether single or coupled, this is about quality over quantity. Deep conversations hit different right now. If you've been ghosting someone or avoiding a convo, the vibe says it's time. Your honesty is your superpower.
weekly.career: You're getting clarity on what drains you versus what lights you up. Trust those gut feelings about projects and people. A collaboration or opportunity might look glossy on the surface—check the details before committing fully.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for intentional rest, not just scrolling in bed. Move in ways that feel good, whether that's dancing, walking, or stretching. The energy supports grounding practices and actually listening to what your system needs.
